In 1857, physicist Michael Faraday conducted some of the first scientific experiments on colloidal gold particles — laying the foundation for what alchemists like Paracelsus had intuited centuries earlier. 🧪✨

From Faraday's flask to modern nanotechnology research: discover the science behind Colloidal Gold.

Get the book: https://aureum-institute.com
